issues.detail: Example only supplies reset=0 but expects q to jump 9->16->17; impossible under increment-by-one and q-based combinational enable.
Condition asserts exact BCD bit mapping and modulo 10000, but spec_quote only cites S01; S02 encoding is not quoted and wrap is not verbatim.
issues.spec_evidence: Each decimal digit is encoded using 4 bits: q[3:0] is the ones digit, q[7:4] is the tens digit, etc.

issues.detail: Rule maps upper digits to ena[0..2], while spec names digits [3:1]; port ena:3 has no declared range.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

issues.detail: Spec is silent on ena timing; rule assumes combinational same-cycle. Alternative: registered enable visible next cycle; at q=9 contract ena=1, alternative ena=0.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.
issues.alternative: Registered active-high ena, visible one cycle after the carry condition q[3:0]==9 is met.
